hints.title: Disjunctive Condition
hints.text: The goal requires either making every row palindromic or making every column palindromic, not necessarily both simultaneously.

hints.title: Row Palindromicity
hints.text: Iterate through each row and compare symmetrical cells from outer edges inward, summing mismatches.

hints.title: Column Palindromicity
hints.text: Similarly iterate through each column and sum vertical symmetrical mismatches. Return the minimum between row and column totals.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Two separate linear scans over all grid cells.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Calculates row and column palindrome flip requirements independently and takes minimum.
